    Changelog

    All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

    The format is based on Keep a Changelog and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

    0.9.0 - 2026-11-10

    Compare with 0.8.0

    0.6.0 - 2026-11-07

    Compare with 0.5.0

    Features

    • Add light-emitting robots that cluster with a sensory delay and spread with a prediction (d748e0b by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add explosive percolation, Davidsen-Ebel-Bornholdt, node merging, duplication-deletion, spatial triadic percolation, and network superposition (4af6aab by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add choice among candidate edges, triadic closure, edge contraction, node duplication, and one drawn member to topology requests (36c9c13 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Adleman's DNA computation of a Hamiltonian path by random ligation (1cad648 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Gooding's evolution by circumstance, with lifespans and starvation, as a regime of RobbyGA (d0623f3 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Lenia with the multi-kernel, multi-channel, and higher-dimensional rules of its expanded universe (f6ddd8e by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Fredkin's replicator, a Turing machine with the busy beaver, and the Game of Life on a small-world network (11979e1 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add the grain storage system (5db7422 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add minimum-time bang-bang control of a free particle, a harmonic oscillator, and a saddle (f1bfa72 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add magnetic levitation under alternating impulses and the electromagnetic vibrating table (edd53b3 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add the memristive mixed-mode oscillator and coupled Colpitts oscillators (ecca92a by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add ant colony optimization, Strombom shepherding, and the EpiSims city (fd30e62 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Bellomo's kinetic crowd in a street with walls (51460a3 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add glycolysis, fate decisions, lateral inhibition, noisy Boolean, logical, Petri, and adaptation circuits (ba7d509 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Ajani's Choice, supply chain diffusion, exploration and preferential return, and container mobility (d76e563 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add household demand, the Fair Food Program, Gooding's double auction and Toy Trader, El Farol coalitions, and the CCC model (0ddc2b1 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add opinion, cooperation, and multilevel selection systems from Jensen, Argun, Cooney, Su et al., and Baumann et al. (00f9aea by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Vicsek variants, inertial and deformable active particles, active polymers, and rigid Brownian bodies (4545d06 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add policy resistance, drift to low performance, watchmakers, random typewriting, and the Big Sort option of Schelling (eddada6 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Kimura diffusion, NKCS, competitive Jain-Krishna, and assembly theory models (e233483 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Brock-Mirman growth, network herding, categorized purchasing power, Mark-0, and five finance systems (253ece1 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Barkley, two-layer sepsis, adaptive flows, a steerable feedback loop, hyperbolic chemotaxis, and WBE (d02dc67 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add graphlet arrival, Kronecker and configuration-model graphs, interdependent cascades, and fitness growth (79b5677 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add Rössler-driven Lorenz, adaptive Kuramoto, NLT topological Kuramoto, delay-coupled maps, sandpile variants, branching, and HPP gas (e1c8c59 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add the associative thought process, next-generation neural mass, STDP network, and adaptive delays (57476b2 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
    • Add the fishery with measurement errors, the rice food balance, and the crop livestock household (21cefa4 by georgedouzas). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
